generation_budget.definition: Complete existing DEV1000; one direct response versus a live native episode. Bounds are ceilings, not forced calls.

population.decision_population: Historically exposed DEV1000; NEW500 primary, OLD500 and pooled secondary. Preserve variable-width candidates and all rows.

purpose: Complete current native agent baseline: Perception proposes up to three intents; source-bound bounded projection selects the complete associated released explanatory slot-card union; Solver jointly chooses intent and extracts entities; Reviewer calls the task-contract tool and reviews; Planner accepts or requests one bounded revision. Only Solver answers. Compare end-to-end against direct frozen-model answering, not a knowledge ablation. No Whisper or intent-boundary-store consumption is claimed.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on failure; no automatic restart, replay, truncation, dose or geometry change. At most one separately registered recovery after a named root cause; second failure closes the flight.
